advisories.title: Gin trusts spoofable X-Forwarded-For headers
advisories.description: Gin before 1.7.7 derives the client IP from headers an attacker controls.

advisories.title: golang.org/x/text out-of-range panic
advisories.description: x/text before 0.3.7 panics on crafted input, enabling denial of service.

advisories.title: Terrapin: SSH transport protocol prefix truncation
advisories.description: x/crypto/ssh before 0.17.0 allows an attacker to strip handshake messages.

advisories.title: jwt-go access restriction bypass
advisories.description: jwt-go allows bypassing audience verification when aud is not a string.
